title: Uiverse
usage: Approved seed. Open an element and copy the HTML/CSS, Tailwind, React, or Figma export from that page. There is no shared package. Read the license on the element page before shipping it; many elements are MIT.
notes:
Approved seed. Uiverse's homepage calls it a community-built library of open-source UI elements you copy as HTML/CSS, Tailwind, React, and Figma. Public curated groups include loading UI, animated buttons, glassmorphism cards, forms, and tooltips. Access to the library is free, so license is free. An element's own license can still differ.

Library-card vibe is locked to 「趣味交互」. It labels this library page, not each element. A human can override it later.
